trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped indentation at the central convergence point of the lobes with an obtuse interior angle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge characterized by a series of low-to-medium amplitude peaks and valleys along both lobes. A prominent jagged peak is visible on the right lobe approximately 80% distance from the notch toward the distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave upward curvature extending from the central notch to the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated cluster of high-contrast, tan-to-orange hued circular and irregular pixel groups located on the extreme distal tip and trailing edge of the right lobe, consistent with external colonization.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable irregular textural mass and discoloration on the right fluke tip; secondary small notches and irregularities present along the trailing edge topography.
